title: Update deploy/aws/README.md to build a versioned image and deploy it by digest
description: Rewrite the Build and Push section of deploy/aws/README.md so operators pass `--build-arg VERSION=<release>`, tag the image `mongodb-mcp-server:<release>` instead of `:latest`, and record the pushed digest from `docker push` output or `aws ecr describe-images`. Operators must point the AgentCore runtime image URI at `<account>.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/mongodb-mcp-server@sha256:<digest>`. Add a rollback note: before each runtime update, record the previous image digest so the runtime can be re-pointed. Use placeholders only; do not put account ids or credentials in the README.
acceptanceCriteria: The README build command includes `--build-arg VERSION=` and the runtime configuration step references an `@sha256:` image URI
The README contains a rollback step that records the previous image digest

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer checks the merged PR diff of deploy/aws/README.md. Expected: no `:latest` tag remains, the build passes --build-arg VERSION, the AgentCore runtime is configured by digest, a rollback step is present, and no secret or account-specific value is added.

rootCause.description: The operator runbook tells people to build without a version argument and push and deploy the mutable :latest tag, which reintroduces unpinned images even after the Dockerfile is fixed.
